title: Free roasted pigs: Koronadal's 13th Lechon Festival draws crowds

blocks.text: KORONADAL CITY, South Cotabato — Residents flocked to the City of Koronadal Integrated Public Transport Terminal on Thursday for the 13th Lechon Festival, where they were served free roasted pigs as part of the Negosyo Festival and 26th Charter Anniversary celebrations. The event brought together the city’s 27 barangays and 12 commercial lechon establishments, which competed for the title of best lechon in their respective categories. Each barangay prepared one roasted pig, and judges scored their entries based on taste, color, and overall presentation. After the judging, the roasted pigs were given to the public.
